canonical_data: Markdown memory files with frontmatter schemas under typed groups; SQLite FTS5 plus optional vector tables as a rebuildable cache
strengths: Markdown files are the source of truth with a deletable, rebuildable index, enforced by test rather than promised in docs
One store reachable through a CLI, an MCP server, host lifecycle hooks, and a skill across three hosts
Managed lifecycle beyond storage: boundary-triggered distillation, sleep consolidation, proposals ledger, temporal validity
Experiment ledger ships with the source including stated caveats on vendor-run figures
weaknesses: No PyPI release; install from a checkout with uv and Python 3.12
Version 0.1.0 with the unattended sleep and consolidation loop unproven at scale
Optional vector fusion adds retrieval latency for unestablished end-to-end accuracy gain
Effectiveness figures are vendor-run on a bounded haystack, not comparable published scores
why_it_matters: A local-first agent memory runtime whose human-legible Markdown truth, rebuildable index, and sleep-time consolidation give coding agents durable memory with no accounts, keys, or network in the read path.
